value_updates.electronic_component_strategy: Keep the initial electronic build as simple as possible using off-the-shelf components.

verdicts.decision_note: The client accepts the off-the-shelf electronic component strategy for the initial prototype; the proposal does not yet establish mechanical applicability, and its delivery timeline is excluded.
Target-specific implementation claim: the initial BOM uses readily available Amazon components while identifying custom-fabricated exceptions.
The custom solenoid dispensing design conflicts materially with the V1 off-the-shelf strategy and requires a client decision between custom fabrication and an available spout.

The client accepts custom stainless-steel spout fabrication, creating an implementation-relevant mechanical and plumbing exception to the off-the-shelf component strategy without making the existing electronic strategy obsolete.
The client's acceptance of the custom stainless-steel spout proposal resolves the preceding component-strategy ambiguity.
